newsitem.title: USA: Inland Steel says looking at spinoff.
newsitem.headline: Inland Steel says looking at spinoff.

text.p: Inland Steel Industries Inc said Sunday that one of its shareholders, Greenway Partners LP, has proposed a spin-off of the company's remaining 87 percent interest in Ryerson Tull Inc.
Inland Steel said its board of directors and management will look at all strategic options, including the spin-off of Ryerson Tull.
Last year, the company completed a recapitalization, which included an initial public offering of Ryerson Tull.
Ryerson is North America's largest distributor and processor of metals.
Inland could be reached immediately for further comment and Greenway could not be reached for reaction to the statement.
